Compiled decision record: 

Summary: The Communications team requests an assistant to draft first versions of press releases and internal briefing notes. The expected benefit is to save half of the current 3 hours per draft. 

Requirements: 
- Draft first versions of press releases from published reports 
- Draft first versions of internal briefing notes 
- Integration with existing publishing workflow 

Risk Level: Minimal 

Controls: 
- Ensure all drafts are edited and approved by a communications officer before publication 
- Do not use AI to make decisions about individuals 

Pattern: No AI 

Monthly Cost Range: $30-$42 

Recommendation: Approve the use case
